params.description: Asset types to filter by (comma-separated). Valid values: `PENDLE_LP`, `SY`, `PT`, `YT`. Leave blank to fetch all assets types.

items.docs:
Returns USD prices for Pendle-supported tokens across all chains. Covers all token types in the Pendle app, including non-Pendle tokens (USDC, WETH, etc.) when they appear as underlying assets.

Prices update approximately every minute.

Filter by `chainId`, asset `id`, or `type` to narrow results.

For real-time PT/YT pre-trade prices that reflect current pool depth, use [Get swapping prices](#tag/sdk/get/v1/sdk/{chainId}/markets/{market}/swapping-prices) instead.

info.name: Get PT / YT / LP historical price by address

params.name: time_frame
params.description: Time interval for OHLCV data aggregation. Valid values: `hour`, `day`, `week`.

params.name: timestamp_start
params.description: ISO Date string of the start time you want to query

params.name: timestamp_end
params.description: ISO Date string of the end time you want to query

items.docs:
Historical price data for PT / YT tokens / LP tokens. We do not support historical prices for **SY and non-Pendle tokens**.

The data is OHLCV data, returned in CSV format with open, high, low, close prices, and volume.

In the case of LP, volume data will be 0. To get the correct volume, use our [Get market time-series data by address](#tag/markets/get/v2/{chainId}/markets/{address}/historical-data) endpoint.


Returns at most 1440 data points.

items.docs:
Returns the flat list of all PT, YT, LP, and SY tokens supported in the Pendle app, across all chains.

Each entry includes: name, symbol, contract address, decimals, expiry timestamp (for PT/YT), and icon URL.

Filter by `chainId`, asset `id`, or `type` (pt, yt, lp, sy).

Prices are not included — use [Get asset prices](#tag/assets/get/v1/prices/assets) to retrieve them separately.
